summary: Fresh full retest of items A-G, the regression sweep and the vendor pager (first time tested), on the preview DB with 6,303 products. PASS: A (one page tap = 1 fetch, page 3 shows 'Page 3 of 26'; a search typed on page 3 resets to 'Page 1 of 1'; the 15s auto-refresh works; opening the screen sends 1 admin fetch + 1 ids fetch, no duplicate). B (the ids call sends this page's 250 ids, passes the ingress, keeps the order and drops unknown ids). C on a fresh login (exactly 1 /products?ids= request). G (the clear button is 44x44 and works). The regression sweep passes: shop search scrolled to 852 cards, offsets 0..840 with no gaps or repeats, with_total=false on every follow-up page, at most 38 DOM nodes, no 'No stores serving your area yet' flash. The Men category shows chip counts All 546 / A 75 / B 40, the server filters by sub-category and the stale-page guard works (75 cards). Search 'Widget' finds the curated products. The Shop Layout multi-picker opens in 0.3s (100 rows) and searches on the server. The bulk-category endpoint rejects Recharge, and the sheet's category list has no Recharge entries. Vendor pager (vendor login token minted locally for the existing session, no data changed): 26 pages, 1 fetch per tap, pages don't overlap, prev/next work, all targets 44x44, testIDs vendor-products-pager / vendor-page-prev / vendor-page-next / vendor-page-N / vendor-products-end are present. FAIL: (1) CRITICAL regression in item C/D, found and fixed by me: when the shop opened with the layout already cached (every app reopen or reload), the curated blocks never got their products. 'All picks', 'Deals for you' and 'Fresh picks' showed empty cards, and the content box for a deleted product showed its title. RCA below; after a one-line fix the reload test passes (products show, both dead blocks hidden). (2) E only partly fixed: a product with sub_category='' and the legacy subcategory set is not counted (badge 1, list 2). (3) F changes search results: 'beauty' gives 1 result instead of 546, 'test' gives 2 instead of 6005, because ix_prod_text indexes only name/brand/tags. The 5 checks in the request pass (Widget=2, 'PERFTEST Product 00500'=1, mobile=Mobiles rows, Produ>=6000, nonsense=0). (4) A: a search change still sends 2 identical admin fetches. (5) The vendor dashboard still gets interest counts from the public first page (GET /api/products) on every load and page tap, which is the item-B bug again. No deprecated Expo packages were checked or changed in this pass.

minor.issue: $ifNull treats sub_category='' as a real value, so a product with sub_category='' and subcategory='X' is grouped under '' and dropped. The badge shows 1 while the list filtered by X shows 2. Use {$cond:[{$in:['$sub_category',[null,'']]}, '$subcategory', '$sub_category']}. Reference: backend/routes/products_public.py:478-480

The text-index short-circuit narrows results whenever ANY row matches the word in name/brand/tags: 'beauty' gives 1 result instead of 546 (whole Beauty category), 'test' gives 2 instead of 6005. Category, sub_category and description matches are lost. Reference: backend/routes/products_public.py:278-288

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY T1. On a warm-cache open, the effect re-runs (lat/lng/currentUserId/pincode change) while the first /products?ids= request is in flight. The cancelled run throws away its response, and the re-run sees the same lastIdsKey and returns without fetching. productsById stays {} and productsResolved stays false for good, so every curated block renders empty and a dead content_box renders its title. A pull-to-refresh (refreshTick) also never re-fetched curated product data. Fix: reset lastIdsKey.current='' in the effect cleanup.

integration_issues.issue: load() calls GET /api/products (public first page, about 60 rows) on every load, page tap and pull-to-refresh to build interested_count. Badges are 0 beyond those rows, and each tap downloads part of the catalogue for nothing. Use /products?ids=<page ids> as in admin/products.tsx. Reference: frontend/app/vendor/dashboard.tsx:101-106

A search change sends 2 identical GET /admin/products (also when the search is cleared). load's identity changes with appliedSearch, so useFocusEffect re-runs and calls load() on top of the reset effect. loadSeq keeps the result correct, so this only costs network. Reference: frontend/app/admin/products.tsx:240-301

issues: The single and multi product pickers share pickSearch/pickVendor. A search or vendor filter set in the multi picker carries into the single picker: it opened with 1 row, and the single picker has no vendor control to clear the filter. Reference: frontend/app/admin/shop-layout.tsx:800-809

Each page renders 250 image cards with ScrollView + map, not virtualised (the vendor page is about 40,000px tall). This can lag or run out of memory on low-end Android. Consider FlatList/FlashList with numColumns. Reference: frontend/app/vendor/dashboard.tsx:467-480, frontend/app/admin/products.tsx:355
The 'How to create a product - Welcome! Let's create your first product' tour opens automatically on a catalogue of 6,303 products and blocks taps until dismissed.

action_items: Review and keep T1's fix in shop-layout-renderer.tsx (lastIdsKey reset in the effect cleanup). Better: dedupe with an in-flight promise per key so re-runs await the same request (warm-cache opens now send 2 ids requests instead of 1). Also reset lastIdsKey in the resolveBlockProducts catch so a failed request can be retried, and set productsResolved=false when the ids key changes.

Search: use the text index only when it returns the same set as the regex. For example, add category, sub_category, subcategory and description to ix_prod_text, or OR the text match with exact category/sub_category equality, or drop the short-circuit (products_public.py:278-288).
Vendor dashboard: replace GET /products with GET /products?ids=<page ids> for interest counts (dashboard.tsx:101).
Admin products: keep load stable through a ref (or store loadPage in a ref) so a search change fires only one fetch.
Shop Layout: give the single picker its own search state, or reset pickSearch/pickVendor when a picker opens.
Consider virtualising the 250-card admin and vendor product pages.
critical_code_review_comments: shop-layout-renderer.tsx:1164-1168: deduping by a ref with no cleanup reset is what caused the empty-blocks bug. Effect-level refs must be reset when the effect is cancelled.

admin/products.tsx: interest lookup goes through /products?ids=, which only returns published rows, so unpublished products always show 0 interest (minor; admin-side interest could come from /admin/products directly).
products_public.py ids branch caps at 300 ids; admin PAGE_SIZE=250 is fine, but there is no guard if PAGE_SIZE grows.

rca_of_issue: Curated blocks empty on reopen: the ShopLayoutRenderer effect depends on [scope, category, pincode, lat, lng, currentUserId, refreshTick]. With a warm cachedGet, resolveBlockProducts runs right away and sets lastIdsKey before the request returns. When auth or location hydrates, a dep changes and the cleanup sets cancelled=true, so the response is discarded at 'if (cancelled) return'. The new run computes the same key and returns early, so no state is ever set. Reproduced on 2 out of 2 reloads (grid-card/hslide/spotlight counts 0, the dead content box title visible) while the ids request itself returned 200. Mitigation applied: lastIdsKey.current='' in the cleanup. Re-verified on 2 reloads: 2/2/2 cards render, the dead grid and dead box are hidden, 2 ids requests per warm open (1 on a fresh login).
